note: Three fixes to the 2D drawing work, found by a review pass over v0.078. An elliptical fin was being drawn at 57% of its span in the side view - a long-standing error the new rulers made readable; only the picture was wrong, never a dimension, mass or template. The + / - zoom buttons held the middle of the canvas rather than the middle of the drawing, so after v0.078's gutters every zoom step slid the rocket off centre. And the roll readout sat under the All stats button, so clicking it opened the drawer instead of straightening the rocket. No numbers change - every simulation gives v0.078's values exactly.
